name: optcatalog_is_damage_mask_slot_ptr_registered
description: OptCatalog_IsDamageMaskSlotPtrRegistered returns whether a pointer matches one of the three registered damage-mask texture-directory slots.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage shares the damage-mask UV smoke because that caller-visible path depends on recognizing registered slot pointers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x479cc0 validates the three-slot global handle scan and 1/0 return contract.
The native smoke verifies positive matches for two registered slots, the original null-slot match behavior, and a negative result for an unregistered pointer.
